headline.title: Siri AI Hands On: A Smart, Helpful Assistant
headline.summary: The latest iteration of Siri AI has been enhanced to provide more conversational interactions and improved assistance capabilities. Users report that the updated assistant is more helpful and accessible in various contexts.

articles.title: Measuring Curriculum Alignment across Topical Coverage, Competency, and Cognitive Depth: A Longitudinal Framework Applied to CS2013 and CS2023
articles.summary: A new study presents a human-in-the-loop pipeline designed to measure the alignment of undergraduate computer science curricula with international guidelines, specifically comparing the CS2013 and CS2023 standards. This framework aims to provide a reliable method for assessing how well programs cover these evolving guidelines over time.

articles.title: AI4SE and SE4AI Exploration: A Decade Looking Back and Forward
articles.summary: The article reviews the evolution of AI and Systems Engineering (SE) over the past decade, highlighting key developments in three phases: foundational, applied, and LLM inflection. It also notes the growth of a research community sparked by a special issue on AI and SE, which has attracted over 250 participants to its annual workshop.

articles.title: BrainG3N: A Dual-Purpose Tokenizer for Controllable 3D Brain MRI Generation
articles.summary: Researchers have introduced BrainG3N, a dual-purpose tokenizer designed to enhance the generation of controllable 3D brain MRIs, which are crucial for clinical neurology and neuro-oncology. This innovation aims to balance the retention of clinical information with the demands of generative modeling, potentially improving data sharing and simulation of disease trajectories.

articles.title: TelcoAgent: A Scalable 5G Multi-KPM Forecasting With 3GPP-Grounded Explainability
articles.summary: TelcoAgent is a new framework designed for scalable and explainable Key Performance Measurement (KPM) forecasting in 5G and next-generation telecom networks. By leveraging a foundation model, it aims to address the limitations of existing machine learning approaches in real-world applications.

articles.title: Rethinking Shrinkage Bias in LLM FP4 Pretraining: Geometric Origin, Systemic Impact, and UFP4 Recipe
articles.summary: The article discusses the limitations of current FP4 training methods for large language models (LLMs), specifically focusing on the Shrinkage Bias associated with non-uniform data formats like E2M1. It highlights the need for alternative approaches, such as the proposed UFP4 recipe, to mitigate these issues and improve efficiency in LLM pretraining.

articles.title: Ensembles of Large Language Models for Identifying EQ-5D Studies in PubMed Based on Their Abstracts
articles.summary: This study explores the effectiveness of ensembles of large language models, including Google's Gemini, in automating the identification of EQ-5D studies in PubMed by analyzing their abstracts. The research aims to improve the efficiency and consistency of systematic literature reviews, addressing the challenges faced by human reviewers in classifying health-related quality-of-life results.

articles.title: DeepSeek-V4: Towards Highly Efficient Million-Token Context Intelligence
articles.summary: The DeepSeek-V4 series introduces two advanced Mixture-of-Experts language models, DeepSeek-V4-Pro with 1.6 trillion parameters and DeepSeek-V4-Flash with 284 billion parameters, both capable of processing context lengths of up to one million tokens. Key architectural improvements include a hybrid attention mechanism and enhanced optimization techniques.

articles.title: StaminaBench: Stress-Testing Coding Agents over 100 Interaction Turns
articles.summary: StaminaBench is a new benchmark designed to evaluate the endurance of coding agents by assessing their ability to handle multiple consecutive interaction turns before failure. The benchmark focuses on real-world coding scenarios, where agents are tasked with implementing and modifying a REST API server in response to a series of procedurally generated change requests.

articles.title: QueryGaussian: Scalable and Training-Free Open-Vocabulary 3D Instance Retrieval
articles.summary: The paper introduces QueryGaussian, a novel method for scalable and training-free open-vocabulary 3D instance retrieval using natural language prompts. It addresses the limitations of existing scene-level embedding approaches by offering a more efficient solution that reduces memory and computational costs associated with complex 3D scenes.

articles.title: SL-S4Wave: Self-Supervised Learning of Physiological Waveforms with Structured State Space Models
articles.summary: The article presents SL-S4Wave, a self-supervised learning framework designed to model long-sequence physiological waveforms, such as electrocardiograms (ECG), using structured state space models. This approach addresses challenges related to high sampling rates, multichannel signal complexity, and limited labeled data in medical time series analysis.

articles.title: SIMBA: ABidirectional Retrieval Forward Simulation Framework for Modeling FY-4A GIIRS Hyperspectral Infrared Radiances Toward NWP Applications
articles.summary: The article introduces SIMBA, a bidirectional retrieval forward simulation framework designed to model hyperspectral infrared radiances from the FY-4A GIIRS for numerical weather prediction applications. It addresses the limitations of existing deep learning methods by facilitating both the retrieval of atmospheric profiles from radiances and the reverse simulation of radiances from atmospheric states.
